description: Find TypeScript source mods for a feature you need, or find Foundation Kit when listed. This public lookup returns mod summaries with IDs and catalog prices, the total mod match count, separate kit matches when available, and pricing policy. Results are limited to a single page, with empty arrays for no matches. Use get_mod_details for a product's full record or get_setup_overview for prerequisites.

category.description: Filter by a catalog category. Use "application" to look for Foundation Kit. Omit to search all categories.

limit.description: Maximum number of standalone mod summaries to return, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 16. Foundation Kit matches are counted separately.

query.description: Keywords or a short description of the feature you need, such as "Stripe billing" or "team workspaces". Omit or leave blank to browse.

name: search_catalog
title: Search Helpful Mods
